Just a demo!

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

```{r}
penguins |> 
  group_by(species) |>
  count()
```

```{r}
penguins |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g), fill = species) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Penguin Body Mass by Spcecies", 
    x = "Species",
    y = "Body Mass (g)"
  )
```
